limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The exact exponent-10 result is claimed; the general offset-semigroup reformulation is not claimed as new. Zenkin's 1995 full text was inspected; it supplies the generalized-Waring framework but not this exact exponent-10 semigroup calculation. No claim is made that exponent 10 is covered by Benfield--Lippard Conjectures 10.1 or 10.2; those conjectures concern power-of-two exponents. No claim is made about the stabilization index g(1,10).
provenance: Mathematical research record. Review evidence is documented in REVIEW.md.
record_title: Exact tenth-power stable obstruction set via a numerical semigroup
